A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work in 55 readable pages, including Appendices A–G. Complete text and rendered-page comparisons identify differences only in the arXiv version/date stamp and the acknowledgments on page 13.

before.justification: v3 reports original planning experiments using simulated environments and robotic data, including baseline comparisons in Table 2, design-choice ablations, and additional analyses in Appendix G.

after.justification: v4 reports the same original empirical results in Section 5 and Appendix G, including quantitative planning evaluations, ablations, and qualitative robotic rollout comparisons.

M1.justification: The encoder/predictor architectures, training objectives, rollout procedures, proposed model recipes, and planning algorithms are identical in both versions.

E1.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix E retain identical coverage of Metaworld, Maze, Wall, Push-T, DROID, Robocasa, and the collected Franka-arm videos.

E2.justification: DINO-WM and V-JEPA-2-AC retain identical participation in the reported comparisons. The CEM, Nevergrad, Adam, and gradient-descent planner comparisons are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The data splits, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and planning settings in Section 5.1 and Appendices C, E, and F are identical.

E4.justification: The design-choice and scaling ablations, failure cases, rollout analyses, and investigations of success-rate proxies are unchanged in Section 5.2 and Appendix G.

E5.justification: Both versions provide the same three-seed reporting for final models, epoch aggregation, error bars, and statistical procedures, including Table 12 and Appendix G.2.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are identical, including Table 2, Appendix G's result tables, and the plotted and visualized outcomes throughout both PDFs.

T1.justification: The mathematical training/planning formulation and Appendix D's autoregressive error-propagation assumptions, propositions, derivations, and proofs are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, proposed optimal recipes in Section 5.3, and conclusion retain identical claims and scope.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, task-dependent interpretations, failure conditions, deterministic-predictor limitations, and broader impact statement are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, and code/data/checkpoint access information are identical. The added funding paragraph supplies no new technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B, and the reference list are identical. The newly acknowledged funding sources do not introduce cited research or change the paper's positioning.

P1.justification: v4 adds one paragraph acknowledging funding and institutional support on page 13 and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. All remaining prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added funding paragraph locally extends the acknowledgments block into existing whitespace on page 13. All figures, tables, captions, pagination, and other page layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 adds funding attribution and updates the version/date stamp, while preserving all scientific content, including the appendices. The disclosure adds transparency but does not meaningfully change the paper's evidence, reasoning, reproducibility, or overall readability.
